title: Admission Eligibility Criteria
content: To be eligible for B.Tech programs at SRM, candidates must meet the following criteria: 1. Nationality: Candidates must be citizens of India, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs), or holders of PIO or OCI cards issued by the Government of India. 2. Age Limit: Candidates should have completed 17 years of age on the 31st of December of the admission year. 3. Academic Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 (Higher Secondary) examination or its equivalent from a recognized board with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (or Biology/Biotechnology for bio-engineering courses) as core subjects. 4. Minimum Marks: A minimum aggregate of 60% in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) in the qualifying 12th standard examination is required for admission across all campuses (Ramapuram, Kattankulathur, Vadapalani, NCR Delhi). For bio-engineering programs, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) marks are accepted with a minimum aggregate of 60%.
